desc: Parse input; store the M bad intervals (already disjoint, sorted, and strictly inside (1, N)).
Represent reachable state as a bitmask of offsets 0..B-1 relative to a current position; define a step function computing reachability at x+1 (OR of bits A-1..B-1).
Process each bad interval [L, R]: advance across the good gap with full-mask shortcut and cycle detection; cross bad squares via O(1) shift (length ≥ B → immediate No).
After the last interval, advance toward N similarly and test bit0 for N.
Combine into a single solve() reading stdin, printing "Yes"/"No".
Test against the three samples plus edge cases (M=0, N small, A=B parity, interval length exactly B, mask dying mid-gap, full-mask jump landing exactly on N).
